app.title: XML Schema Validator
app.subtitle: Validate XML documents against XSD schemas
status.idle: Select an XML document and its XSD schema, then click Validate.
error.select_xml: Select an XML document before validating.
error.select_xsd: Select an XSD schema before validating.
error.xmllint_missing: xmllint could not be found. Install it and try again.
result.success_detail: The XML document fully complies with the XSD schema.
phase.schema_violation.title: The XML does not comply with the schema
phase.schema_violation.explanation: The XML is well formed and the schema compiled successfully. The errors below are schema violations.
phase.schema_compile_error.title: The XSD schema could not be compiled
phase.schema_compile_error.explanation: The schema itself contains errors, so the XML was never validated. Fix the XSD first.
phase.schema_not_found.title: The XSD schema could not be found
phase.schema_not_found.explanation: The schema file could not be opened or located. Check the XSD path.
phase.malformed_xml.title: The XML is not well formed
phase.malformed_xml.explanation: The document is not well-formed XML, so it was never validated against the schema. This says nothing about the XSD.
phase.environment.title: The validation could not run
phase.environment.explanation: The problem is with the environment, not with your files.
detail.timeout: The validation process exceeded {s} seconds and was terminated.
report.no_errors: No errors found. Validated in {s} s.
env.title: xmllint not found
env.explanation: This application relies on xmllint (libxml2) to validate documents. Install it with your package manager, then click Re-detect.
env.macos_note: Homebrew installs libxml2 as keg-only. If detection still fails, use "Locate xmllint..." or add /opt/homebrew/bin to your PATH. macOS also ships /usr/bin/xmllint.
